articleTitle: What Actually Fixes Chronic Neck and Shoulder Pain
imageHeadline: Heat won't fix chronic neck pain. This will.
imageSubtext: The evidence-backed approach most people skip
pinTitle: What Actually Fixes Chronic Neck and Shoulder Pain (Not Heat or Painkillers)
pinDescription: Heat and ibuprofen only mask the pain for a few hours. Research shows exercise therapy — specifically deep neck flexor and scapular strengthening — is the first-line treatment for lasting relief. Learn what the evidence says works, why it takes weeks not days, and what role stress actually plays.

items.label: Strengthen deep neck flexors, not just stretch
Correct forward head posture over weeks, not days
Address stress load on trapezius muscles
